title: fix(app-shell): the Studio header stacks below 640 px instead of overlapping (objectui#12509)
body:
Fixes #12509
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The Studio shell header no longer overlaps on a narrow window.

- Below `sm` (640 px) the header is two rows. Row one: home, the package chip, Create app, Changes, Publish. Row two: the pillar switcher at full width, each segment an equal share and icon-only, its name kept as the link's accessible name and tooltip.
- From `sm` up the header stays one 48 px row of three columns. The right column is now `minmax(max-content,1fr)`: it never drops below Create app + Changes + Publish, so on a tight row the switcher moves left and the package chip truncates. Before, the Create app button slid under Access at exactly 640 px.
- The package chip's trigger can shrink (`min-w-0`) inside its column.
- 1280 px and up is unchanged; every measured coordinate matches before and after.
- All of it is Tailwind classes in `studio-tokens.ts`: `STUDIO_HEADER` changes and `STUDIO_HEADER_PILLAR_NAV` and `STUDIO_HEADER_PILLAR` are new. No JS width read, no inline style, no More overflow (objectui#12452's ruling stands), and every testid and i18n key is unchanged. The desktop note (`engine.studio.desktopHint`) is unchanged.

Measured live (HotCRM 63db83e plus a local writable package with one draft object, console against `objectstack dev --fresh`), header rectangles before and after:

| width | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 375 | switcher under Changes, chip under Create app | 2 rows, 91 px, no overlap |
| 558 | Access under Changes (353 vs 328) | 2 rows, no overlap |
| 640 | Create app under Access (370 vs 394) | 1 row, 48 px, nav ends at 354, Create app starts at 366 |
| 1280 | 1 row | identical |

## Deviations

- Two new tokens beside `STUDIO_HEADER` (same file): the stacked layout needs the switcher's order and column span and the segments' share, and keeping them as tokens lets one test read them.
- `min-w-0` on the package chip trigger (inside `PackageSwitcher`, the chip of the claimed header region): without it the chip ran under Create app at 375 px.
- The card asked for the `sm`-to-`xl` single row 'as today', but today's row overlaps at 640 to about 710 px. The right column's `max-content` floor fixes that. Above about 710 px the columns are equal again and the switcher stays centred.
- The stale `overflow-x-auto` comment above the header is removed; it described the scrolling strip objectui#12459 retired.

## Screenshots

- `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/12509-header-375-light.png`

## Test evidence (head `744b899`)

- New `StudioDesignSurface.narrowHeader-12509.test.tsx`: the token's unprefixed half is the stacked layout (two columns, no fixed height, switcher `order-last col-span-2`, segments `flex-1`); its `sm:` half is the single 48 px row with the right column's `max-content` floor; the real surface wears the tokens, every segment keeps its accessible name and `sr-only xl:not-sr-only` label, and the chip trigger has `min-w-0`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on narrowHeader-12509, desktopHint-11795, accessSegment-12452, pillarNavGuard, packageLessFlows-11553, interfacePolish: 6 files, 38 tests passed. All 78 `StudioDesignSurface.*.test.tsx` files: 129 + 170 + 227 tests passed in three batches.
- Ablation, once each, restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty: the old one-row `STUDIO_HEADER` turns the two token pins red; the nav's old inline class turns the render pin red.
- `type-check` and `build` for `@object-ui/app-shell` pass, as does the 28/28 closure build. eslint on the touched files: 0 errors, and no warning in a changed hunk. `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:test-path-roots` and `check:pending-changeset-literals` all exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of this card's region: at 375 px the Data pillar's item header hides the object title beside the api chip and the draft badge (see the 375 screenshots). It belongs to the DataPillar header (objectui#12511's region).
- Not measured: a long pending-app pill on a narrow screen; the live package showed Create app instead.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01KQyLt9mekyay9X1dPEawfd`.
